gaps.explanation: Statement (Exhibit H, p6) Total operating disbursements/depreciation 9,417 (Water 7,728 + Sewer 1,689) includes Depreciation 1,755 (Water) and has no capital purchases. The detail lines come from Schedule 3 (p10), budgetary cash basis: Water 39,516 + Sewer 1,689 = 41,205. Schedule 4 (p11) prints the reconciliation: 9,417 - depreciation 1,755 = 7,662, plus Purchase of capital assets 33,543 (budgetary basis only; capitalized on the modified cash statement) = 41,205; printed adjustment (31,788). Per fund: Water 7,728 - 1,755 + 33,543 = 39,516; Sewer 1,689 = 1,689. Gap 9,417 - 41,205 = -31,788 = 1,755 - 33,543 exactly. Printed basis difference; no fix.
